scope: Captured ownership for native Log revision popups and submenus

upstream.reference: src/TortoiseProc/GitLogListBase.cpp: popup selection/ref targeting and ContextMenuAction

implementation: Guarded native action target for 46 existing revision selector methods; original captions, icons and represented payloads remain on menu items
Popup snapshots selected hashes, byte-preserving reference metadata and Log generation
Refuses selection/reference changes, reload, blocked/retired owners and duplicate use
Fresh action dispatch remains valid after native popup close; the next popup replaces the retained relay
Recursively binds clipboard, reference, parent and other submenus; async Combine retains its existing guarded item
Header-column and active keyboard/double-click routes retain their separate lifecycles

native.new_scope: Fresh Browse/Export/Checkout/Create Branch/Tag/Reset/Containing Refs/Cherry-pick/Format Patch/Compare callbacks after popup close; private hash clipboard and duplicate refusal; all leaves of a constructed revision popup after selection change; busy/Find/Ordering/ref-picker guards; same-hash NFC/NFD ref change; same-selection reload; working-tree Commit and retired model; unchanged HEAD/index/refs
native.baseline_scope: Existing live Revert and Combine output/recovery/rollback, preserved partial MERGE_MSG, Commit handoff and Log/Sync ancestry/Quit ownership

initial_fixture_repairs.description: A fixture lookup force-unwrapped a missing selector; replaced it with a descriptive throwing lookup.

The newly constructed Log model retained its conservative bare default, omitting working-tree commands. Populate the actual private repository bare state before asserting those commands; assertions retained.

validation.visual: Dispatch-only change; existing captions, artwork, selector names and menu construction layout preserved. No new screenshots or broad visual parity claim.

cleanup.method: Runner reaped each receiver; later ps check found all absent. Fixture uses a private pasteboard/preferences/repositories and closes owned workflow windows.

limits: Physical native menu tracking and full keyboard/VoiceOver acceptance remain open
Source availability masks, all conditional menu variants and other shared-list consumers remain partial
Actual Git operations continue to need their own fresh validation/cancellation; UI ownership is not repository authorization
Signed Finder/App Store and full app parity remain open
